verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a Files API and webhook notifications for changes, but nowhere describes a cursor/delta endpoint (e.g., list_folder/continue) that returns only changed items since a last call; the shown API example (dropbox-gh-1) does a full folder listing, and webhooks (dropbox-docs-4, dropbox-docs-28) merely notify that *something* changed without describing incremental delta retrieval semantics.
